description: This file is a React component for an admin dashboard page that handles displaying, approving, and rejecting user account requests. It includes UI elements, API calls, modals for confirmation, and state management.

methods.name: fetchUserRequests
methods.description: Fetches pending user account requests from the backend API and updates component state.

methods.name: fetchAllRequests
methods.description: Calls fetchUserRequests and manages loading state; also sets up periodic refresh.

methods.name: handleApproveUser
methods.description: Handles approval of a user account with selected role, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: handleRejectUser
methods.description: Handles rejection of a user account request, requiring a rejection reason.

methods.name: getRoleColor
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for role badge based on user role.

methods.name: displayRole
methods.description: Formats role string to start with uppercase letter.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts a date string into a localized, human-readable format.
